name: ExpenseLine
title: ExpenseLine - Global
summary: The ExpenseLine script include is used by various cost management processes and can also be used for generating expense line (fm_expense_line) records from your own server-side scripts.
overview: This script include requires the Cost Management (com.snc.cost_management) plugin.

members.name: ExpenseLine
members.sig: ExpenseLine (GlideRecord source, Number amount, String description)
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
source GlideRecord GlideRecord identifying the source of the expense
amount Number Decimal number identifying the amount of the expense
description String (Optional) Description of the expense.
Returns
Type Description
ExpenseLine object The ExpenseLine object just instantiated. 
//get some random CI to be used as an expense source
        var ci = new GlideRecord("cmdb_ci_server");
        ci.query();
        ci.next();
        
        //create expense line
        var exp = new ExpenseLine(ci, 234.56, "Test expense line");

members.name: createExpense
members.summary: Creates a new expense line record.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True if the expense line was successfully created. 
//get some random CI to be used as an expense sourcevar ci =new GlideRecord("cmdb_ci_server");
ci.query();
ci.next();
 
//create expense line
var exp =new ExpenseLine(ci,234.56,"Test expense line");
exp.setSummaryType("run_business");
var success = exp.createExpense();

members.name: processCIParents
members.summary: Used internally by the createExpense method to process CI relationships when the expense source is a cmdb_ci record.

members.name: setCostSource
members.summary: Identifies the source rate card or distribution cost that was the source of expense line generation.
members.html:
This is not the source (CI, task) of the expense.

Parameters
Name Type Description
costSource GlideRecord GlideRecord of CI rate card cost, distribution cost, or task rate card. This is generally only used for system-generated expense lines.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: setDescription
members.summary: Defines the description of an expense.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
description String Description of expense.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: setParent
members.summary: Sets the parent field on the expense line.
members.html:
This is generally only used by the system when generating indirect expenses such as business service aggregated expenses.

Parameters
Name Type Description
expense GlideRecord Parent expense line record.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: setRecurring
members.summary: Flags the expense as recurring by setting the recurring field to true.
members.html:
Expense lines are set to false by default so there is no need to call setRecurring(false).

Parameters
Name Type Description
recurring Boolean Set to true to identify expense line as a recurring expense.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: setSummaryType
members.summary: Sets a value for the expense line summary_type field.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
summaryType String Typically you would set this to a value already specified in the expense line summary type field choice list.
Returns
Type Description
void 
//get some random CI to be used as an expense sourcevar ci =new GlideRecord("cmdb_ci_server");
ci.query();
ci.next();
 
//create expense line
var exp =new ExpenseLine(ci,234.56,"Test expense line");
exp.setSummaryType("run_business");
